newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sadia near launching $200 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sadia near launching $200 mln bond.

text.p: Brazilian food processing firm Sadia Concordia S.A. said it was close to launching a $200 million bond with a minimum maturity of eight years on U.S. markets.
"We hope to have the money in hand in December," said Sadia president Luiz Fernando Furlan, who added the firm already has held road shows with lead managers Swiss Bank and ING Barings.
Proceeds will help finance a $421 million, four-year investment plan aimed at expanding and modernizing production facilities and installing anti-pollution controls, he said.
International Finance Corp, the finance arm of World Bank, is assisting the company in the debt issue, he added.
Sadia Concordia is the holding company for the Sadia Group, which produces meats, margarine and other food products.
